reason: B is the better proposal because it specifies a single composition change, baseline, measurable targets, environmental limits, and a directly falsifiable comparison, whereas A never identifies an actual precipitate chemistry and is therefore not operationally testable. B remains mechanistically risky—the cited 25 at.% Ag TiNbZr result does not justify 2 at.% Ag in CoCrFeNi, and Ag is more likely to segregate than oxidize—but that uncertainty can be decisively tested.
